//: GTO lookup data configuration. Copy to gto_config.json and edit paths.
//data_root: Base directory that the relative paths below are resolved against.
//preflop: Preflop range file (JS or JSON). 'var' is the assigned global name inside a .js file.
//bet_levels: One entry per pot type. flop/turn are loaded fully at init(); river is loaded per-chunk on demand.
//river_cache: Bounds RAM: keep at most `max_chunks` river files (one per matchup+board) resident. LRU-evicted.
